biggest_catch: The highest $150 tier requires the friend to meet every referral requirement — the referrer always earns less than or equal to the headline tier they see.
catches: Tiered rewards: $75 (basic) or $150 (full) for the referrer depending on how many requirements the friend completes.
The friend must become a new member, meet membership and account qualifications, open savings and checking (or a $5,000 CD), and keep accounts open at least 90 days.
The $75 tier requires 15+ debit transactions in the first 90 days.
Reward is tax reportable; paid 2 business days after requirements are completed.
Cannot be combined with other offers or used for an existing account; may be modified or withdrawn at any time.
Annual cap not disclosed on the observed snippet.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Credit Union of the Rockies' official Member Referral Program page (cu-rockies.org) pays the referrer $75 or $150 per qualifying referral, tiered by the friend's completion level.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: $75 for the referrer (friend gets $50) at the basic tier, or $150 for the referrer (friend gets $100) when the friend completes all requirements.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: refer a new member to Credit Union of the Rockies; the friend completes membership and account qualification steps.

c4.evidence: Timing: reward is deposited into the referrer's primary savings account 2 business days after completion of the reward requirements.

eligibility: Credit Union of the Rockies members 18+ referring new members who meet membership and account qualifications.
notes: Credit Union of the Rockies (Colorado). Tiered: use $75 as the floor; $150 requires the friend to complete all terms. Distinct from R2747's $300 signup bonus.
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of $75.00 (basic tier) to $150.00 (full tier).
payout_quote: $75 will be deposited into your account, and $50 will be deposited into your friend's account. ... Option Three - $150 for you, $100 for your friend. If your friend completes all the steps mentioned above, they will receive $100, and you will receive $150!
payout_value_note: $75 (basic tier) or $150 (full tier) per qualifying referral.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Reward is tax reportable; see a tax professional.

s4.note: Annual cap not disclosed on the observed snippet.

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23).

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: refer a new member; the friend completes membership and account qualification steps.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: become a new member, meet membership and account qualifications, open savings + checking (or a $5,000 CD), complete 15+ debit transactions in 90 days, and keep accounts open at least 90 days.

steps: Refer a friend to Credit Union of the Rockies.
Friend becomes a new member and completes the membership and account qualification steps.
$75 (basic) or $150 (full) is deposited into your primary savings account 2 business days after the requirements are completed.
timing: 2 business days after completion of the reward requirements.
